$comment: What the harness's workflows accept from outside and publish, machine-readable. tests/contract.test.ts fails when this and .github/workflows disagree.

claims_url.meaning: URL the runner can GET without credentials for the release's claims.yaml

rules_url.meaning: URL the runner can GET without credentials for the release's rules.json (docs/contract/rules.schema.json): the Rules a claim may name with rule: "0031". Passed to --rules

runs.meaning: Journey repetitions per side; default 5 (4 is the least that lets timing reach alpha 0.05; see docs/noise-burndown.md)

migrations_a.meaning: Monorepo git ref for production's migrations; default v<production>

migrations_b.meaning: Monorepo git ref for the candidate's migrations; default v<candidate>

production_digests.meaning: Object app -> sha256:<64 hex>: the image production runs, per app. Pins side a (harness images ensure / run --a-digests): pulled and verified by digest, refused with exit 2 when the tag now resolves to another digest

candidate_digests.meaning: Object app -> sha256:<64 hex>: the candidate image, per app. Pins side b (--b-digests), and is what the release record keeps

production.meaning: The tag that was deployed, e.g. 16.3.0; names the release record to compare with

digests.meaning: Object app -> sha256:<64 hex>: the images that run. Compared with the release record; a difference or no record is a warning, never a failure

tools.$comment: Installed by every job that runs `harness images ensure`. Verifying the monorepo's signatures needs cosign >= 3.

grype.$comment: Since 1.4.0. Installed, at one pinned version, by the jobs that judge images: nightly noise job, release job, mutants job. Not ci.yml (a smoke run) or post-deploy.yml (no images), and not the release workflow's migration and upgrade jobs (the release job judges the images).

syft.$comment: Since 1.4.0: pinned. Generates the mutants' SBOMs; the images of a nightly and a release carry an SBOM attestation.

vulnerabilityDatabase.$comment: Since 1.4.0. Fetched once per job by `harness vuln-db update`, cached per UTC day and grype version, never updated during a run (docs/images.md). tests/workflows-vuln.test.ts holds the workflows to this.
vulnerabilityDatabase.fetch: pnpm harness vuln-db update, only on a cache miss, continue-on-error
vulnerabilityDatabase.status: pnpm harness vuln-db status, after the fetch, before any run

thirdPartyCache.$comment: Since 1.5.0. What the apps load in the browser from Google Fonts, Iconify and jsDelivr, recorded once and answered from that copy on both sides (src/collectors/third-party-cache.ts). Every job that installs Chromium restores it before its first command and saves it, under the hash of its content, when the run recorded something new. tests/workflows-third-party.test.ts holds the workflows to this.

writePermissions.$comment: The only `write` scopes any workflow or job holds, all on THIS repository (since 1.2.0 for nightly-noise.yml and release.yml). the key <workflow> means the workflow-level permissions. tests/contract.test.ts fails on any other.

main-preview.yml.why: since 1.5.0, pushes the `main-preview` branch: each Main to RC forecast's report and scorecard (reports/index.json), and since 1.13.1 its confidence.json and changes.json

pages.yml.why: since 1.5.0, deploys the kept reports of the release-records, main-preview and noise branches to GitHub Pages; writes no branch

nightly-noise.yml.why: force-pushes the `noise` branch: noise-status.json, noise-history.json, noise-summary.md

post-deploy.yml.why: opens the `rollback` issue when post-deploy mode exits 1

tags.yml.why: since 1.7.0, creates the tag v<version> on the first commit of main that carries each version (scripts/release-tags.sh); never moves a tag or writes a branch

release.yml.why: override-record opens a `harness-override` issue for each FAIL that a person overrode with override_reason; publish-record (since 1.3.0) pushes the release record to the `release-records` branch; scoreboard (since 1.11.0) appends the run's line to the `scoreboard` branch

weekly-mutants.yml.why: since 1.11.0, appends a scheduled or dispatched self-test's mutants caught to the `scoreboard` branch; never on a pull request

noiseBranch.$comment: Since 1.2.0. The stable home of the latest A/A status, so release.yml and post-deploy.yml can find it after the artifact has expired.
noiseBranch.freshness: the gate, not the fetch: a status is trusted only while clean, without degraded, and no more than 7 days old

releaseRecordsBranch.$comment: Since 1.3.0. What release mode judged, kept where post-deploy.yml can find it after the artifact has expired. Not force-pushed: one commit per candidate.

mainPreviewBranch.$comment: Since 1.5.0. Main to RC: release mode with production on side a and the monorepo's main on side b, a forecast kept apart from the release records so post-deploy never mistakes it for a judged candidate. Not force-pushed; the last 60 runs are kept, and since 1.16.0 every run of the last 10 days whatever the count, each with its migration and upgrade rehearsals.

scoreboardBranch.$comment: Since 1.11.0. The release scoreboard, kept on a data branch because main takes changes only through a pull request. Append-only and never forced: one commit per line, and each job checks the file before its push is exactly the start of the file after. A PR may copy the files to scoreboard/ on main, where `harness guard scoreboard` lets it only add lines.

runNames.$comment: Since 1.4.0. The title of a run (the API's display_title), so the monorepo's release-harness-report workflow can find the run a release-candidate dispatch started. Matched as a whole tag: rc.1 does not match rc.10.

dispatchInputs.$comment: workflow_dispatch inputs added in 1.2.0. Not repository_dispatch payload fields: a dispatch from another repository cannot override.

release.yml.override_reason: Accept a harness FAIL and say why; recorded in report.json (override) and in a harness-override issue
